evidence: mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:493 — the Screen.CreateListing composable wires `onSubmit = { _ -> Result.failure(NotImplementedError("Wire to listing API")) }`. The entire realtor create-listing flow is non-functional in production: a realtor who opens the form and taps submit always receives a failure, never a created listing.

Full reachable production path traced (hence confidence high): MyListingsScreen `onCreateClick` (Navigation.kt ~:487) navigates to `Screen.CreateListing.route` => the composable above => onSubmit. CreateListingScreen.kt:41 declares `onSubmit: suspend (CreateListingInput) -> Result<Unit>` and at :95-121 collects the full form input, calls onSubmit(...) and branches `onSuccess = { onCreated() }`, so the UI/form is complete and ready — only the handler is a stub.

Root cause: PortalListingsRepository.kt exposes only listMyListings (:40), getListingAnalytics (:74) and getPortfolioAnalytics (:111) — there is NO create method, and no POST /api/v1/portal/listings (or equivalent) call exists anywhere in the shared module (grep for create/post across shared confirms none). So the stub cannot be removed without first adding the repository method + wiring.

Landable remedy (mobile-native only): add `suspend fun createListing(input: CreateListingInput): Result<ListingId>` (or Result<Unit>) to PortalListingsRepository backed by the reality-server create endpoint, then replace the Navigation.kt:493 lambda with a call to it. Verifiable statically + via a commonTest mock-engine repository test asserting the POST body and success/failure mapping (the repo already has sibling path-encoding/analytics tests to mirror). Severity medium: no crash/data-loss/security impact, but a complete user-facing realtor feature is dead on a shipped navigation route.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/listing/ListingRepository.kt:118 — `suspend fun getListingsNearby(latitude, longitude, radiusKm, limit): Result<ListingSearchResponse>` (calls GET /api/v1/listings/nearby) has ZERO call sites in the whole repo: grep for `getListingsNearby` across mobile-native/ returns only its own declaration (no androidApp screen, no iOS/Swift, no ViewModel references it).

It also has NO test: grep for `getListingsNearby` across *Test.kt files is empty, whereas its sibling methods in the same file (search, suggestions) and the LayoutRepository are covered by mock-engine commonTest suites (e.g. LayoutRepositoryTest). The implementation itself is fine (try/catch -> Result, status check), so this is a low-severity completeness/test-gap smell, not a correctness bug. Remedy options (mobile-native only): either wire it into a nearby-listings UI surface and add a mock-engine commonTest (asserting lat/lng/radius_km/limit query params + success/failure mapping, mirroring the existing path-encoding tests), or delete it if the nearby feature is not planned. Confidence medium: reachability traced by static grep only, not runtime-confirmed.
